scripts.check: pnpm run lint && tsc -p web/tsconfig.json --noEmit && node --experimental-strip-types --test shared/routes.test.mjs web/src/preview-request.test.mjs && cd server && go test ./...
scripts.image:build: test -z "$(git status --porcelain)" || { echo 'commit first: the image tag and OG_VERSION are the 8-char commit hash' >&2; exit 1; } && v=$(git rev-parse --short=8 HEAD) && docker buildx build --platform linux/amd64 --build-arg OG_VERSION=$v -t oginstagram:$v --load . && echo oginstagram:$v
